The '''United Alignment of Nations''' was the main anti-Vesperan coalition during the [[Avant Great War]]. It fought the [[Imperial Pact]] and became the victorious coalition responsible for dismantling the [[Vesperan Empire]] after 1949.

The United Alignment should not be confused with AGGPI. The United Alignment was a wartime coalition built to defeat an imperial bloc. The [[Avant Garde Global Peace Initiative]] was a later peace and deterrence framework formed in November 1994 after the Solara-Khalindar War.

== Formation ==

The coalition grew out of states and alliances threatened by Vesperan expansion, including powers connected to older anti-imperial or regional defense systems. Its membership shifted as the war expanded and as occupied peoples, client-state breakaways, and strategic partners entered the conflict.

Solara was one of the major anti-Vesperan powers. Khalindar entered the anti-Vesperan war effort after the [[Solaran-Khalindarian Conference of 1940]], where Solara promised territorial, economic, infrastructure, and military rewards in exchange for Khalindarian support.

== War Role ==

The United Alignment coordinated military strategy, industry, naval operations, intelligence, and postwar planning against the Imperial Pact. Its forces fought across multiple continents and seas, eventually breaking Vesperan military power and collapsing the imperial state.

== Postwar Role ==

After 3 December 1949, the United Alignment became responsible for occupation policy, demilitarization, relief, and provisional governance in former Vesperan territories. This work was complicated by the [[Continuation War]] and by disagreement among the victors over borders, reparations, and the future of liberated states.

The coalition's postwar compromises created unresolved disputes, including the [[Khalindarian reparations dispute]].
